notes.title: Improved UI + Tutorial!!!
notes.content:
In this update we have added a tutorial as well as improved the UI. We also tried some balance changes to make the game slightly less hard.
Have fun playing!

notes.title: Minor Update March 29
notes.content:
I am issuing a minor update with the following changes:
Drag to place (disable-able in settings)
Fixed crash bug in secret level
Fixed discrepancy between Mac, Linux, and Windows with easy mode starting walls
NOTE: I have not fixed/added audio for placing towers so um yea that will hopefully come soon
